title: Count the Number of Consistent Strings
statement: You are given a string `allowed` whose characters are all different, and an array of strings `words`. Call a word consistent when each of its characters also occurs somewhere in `allowed`. Return how many entries of `words` are consistent (an entry that appears several times is counted each time).
constraints: The characters of allowed are distinct
allowed and every words[i] contain only lowercase English letters
notes:
## Intuition

A word is consistent exactly when none of its letters is missing from `allowed`. Searching the `allowed` string for every letter works (it has at most 26 characters), but putting its letters into a set turns each check into a single constant-time lookup. Then scan each word and stop at the first letter that is not in the set.

## Approach

1. Put the letters of `allowed` into the set `permitted`, and set `count` to 0.
2. For each `word`, assume it is consistent.
3. Check each `char` of the word; the first one not in `permitted` marks the word inconsistent and ends the scan of that word.
4. If the word survived the scan, add 1 to `count`.
5. Return `count`.

## Example 1, step by step

`allowed = "ab"`, so `permitted = {a, b}`.

- `"ad"`: `a` is fine, `d` is not: inconsistent.
- `"bd"`: `d` again: inconsistent.
- `"aaab"`: every letter is `a` or `b`: `count = 1`.
- `"baa"`: consistent: `count = 2`.
- `"badab"`: `d` breaks it.

The answer is `2`.

## Complexity

- Time: O(a + L), where a is the length of `allowed` and L is the total length of all words: each letter is looked up once.
- Space: O(a) for the set, at most 26 letters.

## Pitfalls

- Count words, not letters: one bad letter rules out the whole word, and `count` grows by at most 1 per word.
- Repeated words are counted every time they appear.
- Reset `consistent` to `true` for each new word.
- A 26-bit mask of `allowed` is an equally fast alternative: a word fits when its own mask has no bit outside it.

## Variables

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `permitted` | set of the letters in `allowed` |
| `count` | number of consistent words found so far |
| `word` | the word being checked |
| `consistent` | whether every letter of `word` seen so far is permitted |
| `char` | the letter being checked |

narration.5: Examine the words one by one.
narration.6: Assume this word is consistent until a bad letter shows up.

narration.17: Return how many words were consistent.
